select * from workshop_version where id=#{id} for update
select * from workshop_version where source_kind='PRIVATE_TEMPLATE' and review_state='APPROVED' and id < #{before} order by id desc limit 51

mapper.update: update workshop_version set review_state=#{reviewState},approved_at=if(#{reviewState}='APPROVED',current_timestamp(3),null) where id=#{id} and audit_task_id=#{auditTaskId} and review_hash=#{reviewHash} and review_state='PENDING'
update workshop_version set review_state='WITHDRAWN' where version_id=#{versionId} and seller_id=#{owner} and review_state in ('DRAFT','PENDING','APPROVED','REJECTED')
mapper.select: select * from workshop_order where provider='APPLE_IAP' and apple_bundle_id=#{bundle} and apple_environment=#{environment} and apple_original_transaction_id=#{originalId} for update
mapper.update: update workshop_order set state='REFUNDED',license_status='REVOKED', refunded_at=coalesce(refunded_at,#{revokedAt}),revoked_at=coalesce(revoked_at,#{revokedAt}), revoke_reason='APPLE_BOUND_ORIGINAL_REVOCATION' where order_no=#{orderNo} and buyer_id=#{owner} and provider='APPLE_IAP' and apple_original_transaction_id=#{originalId} and paid_at is not null
mapper.select: select * from workshop_order where provider='APPLE_IAP' and (app_account_token=#{token} or apple_original_transaction_id=#{originalId}) for update
mapper.update: update workshop_order set state='PAID',license_status='ACTIVE',paid_at=#{paidAt}, apple_transaction_id=#{transactionId},apple_original_transaction_id=#{originalId},apple_fact_hash=#{factHash} where order_no=#{orderNo} and buyer_id=#{owner} and provider='APPLE_IAP' and state='PENDING' and license_status='UNPAID' and apple_transaction_id is null

update workshop_order set state='REFUNDED',license_status='REVOKED', apple_transaction_id=coalesce(apple_transaction_id,#{transactionId}), apple_original_transaction_id=coalesce(apple_original_transaction_id,#{originalId}), apple_fact_hash=coalesce(apple_fact_hash,#{factHash}),apple_revocation_hash=#{factHash}, paid_at=coalesce(paid_at,#{paidAt}),refunded_at=#{revokedAt}, revoked_at=coalesce(revoked_at,#{revokedAt}),revoke_reason='APPLE_REVOCATION' where order_no=#{orderNo} and buyer_id=#{owner} and provider='APPLE_IAP'

mapper.insert: insert into workshop_version(version_id,seller_id,request_id,request_hash,module_id,source_canonical_id, content_hash,content_json,terms_hash,terms_json,price_fen,source_kind,review_state) values(#{versionId},#{owner},#{requestId},#{requestHash},#{moduleId},#{sourceCanonicalId}, #{contentHash},#{contentJson},#{termsHash},#{termsJson},#{priceFen},'PRIVATE_TEMPLATE','DRAFT') on duplicate key update version_id=version_id
mapper.select: select * from workshop_version where version_id=#{versionId} for update
select * from workshop_version where seller_id=#{owner} and request_id=#{requestId} for update
mapper.insert: insert into workshop_order(order_no,buyer_id,request_id,request_hash,version_id,amount_fen,provider,state,license_status, version_review_hash,currency,amount_milliunits,app_account_token,apple_bundle_id,apple_environment,apple_product_id) values(#{orderNo},#{owner},#{requestId},#{requestHash},#{versionId},#{amountFen},#{provider},'PENDING','UNPAID', #{reviewHash},#{currency},#{amountMilliunits},#{accountToken},#{bundleId},#{environment},#{productId}) on duplicate key update order_no=order_no
mapper.select: select * from workshop_order where order_no=#{orderNo} for update

select o.*,coalesce(i.buyer_id,l.buyer_id) as installation_owner,cast(m.member_id as signed) as draft_owner, coalesce(i.command_json,l.command_json) as installation_command from cms_member_template m left join workshop_install i on i.draft_id=m.id left join workshop_draft_lineage l on l.draft_id=m.id inner join workshop_order o on o.order_no=coalesce(i.order_no,l.order_no) where m.id=#{draftId} for update of o
select distinct template_id,merchant_member_id from cms_topic_node where topic_id=#{topicId} and template_id>0 order by template_id
select * from workshop_order where buyer_id=#{owner} and request_id=#{requestId} for update
select * from workshop_order where buyer_id=#{owner} and id < #{before} and paid_at is not null order by id desc limit 51
mapper.update: update workshop_order set state='PAID',license_status='ACTIVE',payment_fact_id=#{factId},payment_fact_hash=#{factHash}, paid_at=#{paidAt} where order_no=#{orderNo} and state='PENDING' and buyer_id=#{owner}

update workshop_order set state='REFUND_PENDING',license_status=if(license_status='REVOKED','REVOKED','SUSPENDED'), refund_no=#{refundNo},refund_requested_at=current_timestamp(3) where order_no=#{orderNo} and buyer_id=#{owner} and state='PAID'
update workshop_order set refund_dispatch=#{result} where order_no=#{orderNo} and buyer_id=#{owner} and state='REFUND_PENDING'

update workshop_order set state='REFUNDED',license_status='REVOKED',refund_fact_id=#{factId},refund_fact_hash=#{factHash}, refunded_at=#{refundedAt},revoked_at=coalesce(revoked_at,#{refundedAt}),revoke_reason=coalesce(revoke_reason,'REFUND') where order_no=#{orderNo} and buyer_id=#{owner} and state='REFUND_PENDING'

update workshop_order set license_status='REVOKED',revoked_at=current_timestamp(3),revoke_reason='BUYER_REVOKED' where order_no=#{orderNo} and buyer_id=#{owner} and paid_at is not null and license_status!='REVOKED'
mapper.insert: insert into workshop_install(buyer_id,request_id,order_no,command_hash,command_json) values(#{owner},#{requestId},#{orderNo},#{commandHash},#{commandJson}) on duplicate key update request_id=request_id
mapper.select: select * from workshop_install where buyer_id=#{owner} and request_id=#{requestId} for update
mapper.update: update workshop_install set outcome_json=#{outcomeJson},draft_id=#{draftId},installed_at=#{installedAt} where buyer_id=#{owner} and request_id=#{requestId} and outcome_json is null
